title: Maple Nut Granola
description: Crunchy, clustery oven-baked granola with oats, almonds, pecans and coconut, sweetened lightly with maple syrup.

image.alt: A bowl of clustered maple granola with nuts

ingredients.item: neutral oil or melted coconut oil

steps.text: Heat the oven to {temp 300F oven} with a rack in the middle. Line the baking sheet with parchment.
Mix the oats, almonds, pecans, coconut, cinnamon and salt in a large bowl.
Whisk the maple syrup, oil and vanilla together, pour over the oats and stir until everything is evenly coated and looks damp.
Spread the mixture on the sheet and press it down firmly with a spatula into an even layer. Pressing helps it form clusters.
Bake until golden brown and fragrant, {time 30-35 min}, turning the pan halfway through. Don’t stir, or you’ll break up the clusters.
Let the granola cool completely on the sheet, at least {time 30 min notimer}; it crisps as it cools. Break it into clusters and stir in the raisins.

notes: Store in an airtight jar at room temperature for up to 2 weeks.
Oats are only gluten-free when labelled so; use certified oats if that matters to you.
